suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document the FK-based atomic operations pattern as the standard for parent-child entities. Include a checklist: (1) queue parent sync first, (2) insert children with FK reference, (3) queue child sync with parent FK in payload, (4) no syncGroupId needed.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Both PurchaseService and DistribucionService successfully implement this pattern. PurchaseService.createWithItems and DistribucionService.createWithItems demonstrate the pattern.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add a migration checklist for consuming code property name updates when services migrate. Common properties that change: supplier_id → supplierId, purchase_date → purchaseDate, total_amount → totalAmount, invoice_number → invoiceNumber, etc.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Features m4-fix-purchase-consuming-code and m4-fix-distribucion-consuming-code both addressed this. Worker had to manually grep for snake_case patterns.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document that generated hooks.ts has pre-existing type errors unrelated to migrations. These are generator architectural issues tracked for future fixes.
